name: Runswick Bay Hotel
accommodation: Six en-suite double rooms (two can be twin or triple) on a B&B basis; also Coach House Cottage self-catering
suitableFor: Couples, small groups and dog owners
parking: Hotel car park; EV charging point for guests
dogs: Dogs welcome in all areas of the hotel
beachAccess: About five minutes' walk from the beach, at the top of the bay
confirmedFeatures: Two bars, dining room, open fire in winter, rear ramp access, EV charging
overview: A small hotel in the upper village at Runswick Bay, about five minutes' walk from the beach. It has six en-suite rooms on a B&B basis, two bars and a dining room, and also lets Coach House Cottage. Dogs are welcome throughout, and the Cleveland Way runs through the car park.
surfTripFit: A short walk to the bay with a car park and dog-friendly bars, so you can check the surf and return for food by the fire.
